insight: Acquired by OpenAI in March 2026; stays open-source and MIT-licensed, and is used internally by both OpenAI and Anthropic.
name: Promptfoo
tagline: Open-source LLM eval CLI. Rubric scoring + golden sets.
description: YAML-driven eval harness. Pair a prompt with a goldset, define rubrics, run across multiple models in CI. Strong for catching prompt regressions before they hit production.
edge: Define evals in plain YAML and run one goldset across models in CI — a prompt regression fails the build like any other test.
cons: CLI-first, less of a hosted UI
Config sprawl on large eval suites
